## Summary Table

This is a summary table of the maximum bill length by species.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(
    mean_bill = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_bill = median(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_bill = max(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## Plot

This is a plot table of the maximum bill length by species.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(
    max_bill= max(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_bill = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_bill = median(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = species, y = mean_bill)) +
  geom_col(fill = "tomato") +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Bill Length by Penguin Species",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Mean Bill Length (in mm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
